cohort: Singleton infants born at term in Sweden from 2009 to 2015 with an Apgar score of at least 7 at 5 and 10 minutes
finding: In this Swedish cohort study, several intrapartum complications, including obstetric emergencies, intrapartum fever and/or chorioamnionitis, and fetal distress, were strongly associated with an increased risk of seizures in vigorous term-born neonates.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of seizures in vigorous term-born neonates.
